# How to set up Obsidian for the workspace

1. Open the folder `brains/` as a vault, not the workspace root.
2. Keep *Use [[Wikilinks]]* off and *New link format* on *Relative path to file*.
3. Leave *Automatically update internal links* on, so moving a note fixes its links.
